documents.text: Bluebird Cafe opens at 7:00 a.m. and closes at 3:00 p.m. every day.
Pine Street Library loans books for 14 days. Readers can return books at the front desk.
City bus route 4 stops beside the town museum. The stop is called Museum Square.
The community garden is watered every Tuesday morning by the green shed.
Harbor Point Lighthouse flashes a red light once every 10 seconds after sunset.
Harbor Point Lighthouse stands on a rocky island at the mouth of the bay.
Maple Lane Bakery makes sourdough bread with a starter prepared from rye flour.
